narrative_sample: You experiment aggressively, cycling through nearly a different opening every game, but this breadth comes at the cost of consistency—your openings regularly produce critical errors that often decide your games before the middlegame. Your reliance on offbeat lines like the Chigorin Variation with 3.Bf4 reveals a taste for unconventional play, yet tactical oversights dominate your losses, reflecting a struggle to balance complexity with accuracy. Your split 50% record masks volatility born from unsteady early phases rather than endgame endurance.
